records.title: The Grey Fairy Book
ancientAuthors: Andrew Lang (editor of translations/adaptations from varied traditions)
records.translator: Multiple contributors; Lang edited and adapted selections
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: Lang's anthology preface names Lithuania among many source regions, but individual tales are not consistently tagged with their origin; do not use the volume as undifferentiated Baltic evidence.

records.title: Fairy Tales From Far and Near
records.translator: not applicable; authored in English by Katherine Pyle
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: Pyle's 1922 children's collection labels 'The Princes and the Friendly Animals' a Lithuanian story, but gives no underlying source text or oral informant; the retelling is not a full Baltic tradition source.
